args.title: Add group_aggregate feature with numeric helpers
args.body:
## Summary

Adds a new `group_aggregate(records, key, aggregations)` function to `src/dataproc/core.py` that groups records by a key and applies named aggregations (`sum`, `mean`, `count`, `min`, `max`) to specified fields, returning one row per group in first-seen order.

## Supporting helpers

Two pure helpers added in a new `src/dataproc/helpers.py` module:

- `coerce_numeric(value)` — safely converts values to numbers, returning `None` for non-numeric input (including `None` and `bool`); parses numeric strings.
- `merge_group_keys(records, keys)` — builds a composite grouping key (tuple) from multiple fields, using `None` for missing fields.

## API

`src/dataproc/__init__.py` now exports `group_aggregate`, `coerce_numeric`, and `merge_group_keys`.

## Tests

- `tests/test_group_aggregate.py` — normal paths for every aggregation, multiple aggregations per call, group ordering, empty input, empty aggregations, unknown aggregation (`ValueError`), missing key/value fields (`KeyError`), count ignoring missing fields, negative/zero boundary values, and input-immutability.
- `tests/test_helpers.py` — int/float/string/whitespace/negative parsing, empty/whitespace/non-numeric → `None`, `bool`/`None` → `None`, other `Number` types, single/multiple/missing keys, empty records, empty keys (`ValueError`), and immutability.

All 53 tests pass. Functions are pure and follow existing style. No project-infrastructure files were touched.

## Notes on coordination

This change touches `src/dataproc/core.py`, an area where `sam-lee` has an in-progress refactor (`refactor/core-cleanup`). My change is additive (a new function + new module + additive exports) and does not delete or rewrite existing functions, so it should merge cleanly, but flagging for coordination during review.
